messages:
incident-bot: Paging SRE rotation: high error rate on user-facing inference routes in us-west-2, fallback loop detected. 500s and content-type mismatches reported. Please join #incidents asap.

sre_alex: on it. seeing a spike in gen->embed fallbacks. logs show 'variant_anchor=v1-instruct' for alias 'user-chat' — that looks wrong.

emma_oncall: I got the page. live look: 1m error rate 12% -> 2xx dropped to 86%. customer-facing latency up. any impact to paid tenants?

maria_pm: ~10 customers hitting conversations endpoint; support already has three RT tickets. need quick isolation.

ryan_infra: copying logs: ````
[2026-03-15T17:02:10Z] route=user-chat request_id=abc123 anchor_variant=v1-instruct fallback_variant=v2-embed result=500 schema_mismatch
[2026-03-15T17:02:11Z] route=user-chat request_id=abc124 anchor_variant=v1-instruct fallback_variant=v2-embed result=500 schema_mismatch
````
This looks like alias 'user-chat' got anchored to an instruct variant that returns text-only instruct format, then runtime tries embedding/encode path -> fails.

emma_oncall: any recent routing changes? can we check recent routing policy commits?

sre_alex: checking git: `infra-routing` repo, most recent PR merged 3h ago by ops-bot: commit c3f9b2 (alias mapping automation tweak). It included a fallback prioritization change: prefer anchor from model catalog heuristics. Seems a heuristic misclassified a legacy alias and set anchor to instruct.

ryan_infra: running dry-run query against policy store: ``curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER' https://router.internal/policies/alias/user-chat``

ryan_infra: output: ``{"alias":"user-chat","anchor_variant":"v1-instruct","fallbacks":["v2-chat","v2-embed"]}``

katie_support: customers reporting truncated structured responses and 500s when the product tries to parse embeddings. one customer disabled feature to mitigate.

emma_oncall: impact: medium-high. plan: 1) temporarily remove anchor set for alias to let routing fall back to stable variant v2-chat; 2) roll back heuristic PR; 3) postmortem. Who can patch the policy store quickly?

sre_alex: I can patch now. will push a safe change to set anchor_variant to null for user-chat so it chooses pinned stable variant.

sre_alex: command: ```
# set anchor to null for alias
curl -X PATCH "https://router.internal/policies/alias/user-chat" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"anchor_variant": null, "fixed_variant":"v2-chat"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued: policy-update job id=policy-4528. will apply to us-west-2 first.

sre_alex: applied to us-west-2. verifying...

ryan_infra: can confirm: policy store now shows "anchor_variant": null, "fixed_variant":"v2-chat" for user-chat. routing table reloaded on edge nodes.

incident-bot: automated alert: error rate decreased from 12% -> 1.1% in 90s after policy change.

emma_oncall: good. customer impact window: ~T+12m. katie please update the active RT tickets with mitigation note and ETA for full rollback.

katie_support: on it. updating customers: "We've temporarily pinned your chat route to a compatible chat variant (v2-chat) to stop errors. Engineering is rolling back the automation that caused the mis-anchoring. We'll follow up with a postmortem." :thumbsup:

maria_pm: need timeline for rollback of heuristic change and test plan to prevent future misclassification.

sre_alex: immediate next steps: 1) revert ops-bot PR in infra-routing (PR #482) — I started the revert PR, requesting review from ops. 2) add stronger validation in the automation that ensures alias types (chat vs embed) map to compatible families. 3) run dark-traffic test in staging to validate heuristics.

ryan_infra: revert PR merged to main at commit d4a1ee, will roll forward to policy store during next deploy. adding guard: reject anchor_variant if model.family != alias.expected_family.

emma_oncall: monitoring for 30m. if anything regresses, escalate to SEV2 and call the on-call SRE.

sre_alex: added a quick audit query to find other aliases mis-anchored: ```
SELECT alias FROM policy_store WHERE anchor_variant IS NOT NULL AND alias_expected_family != model_family(anchor_variant);
```

sre_alex: found 3 more aliases (internal-tooling-chat, experiment-route-7, partner-sync) — planning safe update to set fixed_variant to last-known-good for each.

maria_pm: schedule postmortem for tomorrow 10am PT. include SRE, infra, product, support. We need to assess customer impact, SLA hits, and change controls.

katie_support: created customer comms draft and incident ticket INC-2256, linking affected customers.

emma_oncall: thanks everyone. summary for pager: root cause = automation heuristic anchored aliases to incompatible model family (instruct) for a chat alias -> runtime attempted incompatible fallback (embed path) -> 500s. mitigation = clear anchor + pin to v2-chat then rollback heuristic. next: validation in automation + audit.

sre_alex: closing active outage. will keep thread open for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. severity: SEV3. incident created INC-2256.
